say:1:1130132001:1.text: They belong to a merchant named Ted, and I'm just guarding them for now.
say:1:1130132001:1.source_cn: 它们属于一位叫做塔林塔的商人，我只是暂时看守它们。

say:2:1130132002:1.text: After discovering our clan, he decided to use it as a place for the whole caravan to rest up.
say:2:1130132002:1.source_cn: 他在发现我们部落后，准备带领商队来这里，把这作为暂时的...

say:3:1130132003:1.text: When that time comes, maybe Nick can sell some pelts to them.
say:3:1130132003:1.source_cn: 说不定，到时候尼克斯的皮毛也可以卖给他们。

say:4:1130132004:1.text: But I've got to keep a good eye on his stuff until he gets back.
say:4:1130132004:1.source_cn: 不过在他回来之前，我得帮他看好这些货物。
